notes: Authoritative record spec for the Redguard state-enum-gated race. GATE TYPE = state-enum-gated (R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_RedguardSect (Crown=0 | Forebear=1 | AshAbah=2, fallback Forebear) plus the focused Yokudan patron's piety tier within that sect; the focused patron is offer-like inside the sect filter (mirror SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards/Family one-active-focus logic). PROGRESSION CURRENCY = sect-coded signal days (Crown/Forebear: 2 sect-coded signal days in 7; Ash'abah: major death/undead/tomb/funerary/impurity burden). State pace, NOT a raw combat faucet. Broad worship is a STATE on PATRON_STATE_BROAD (R1), NOT a deity -- there is NO PDV_Deity_AncestorSpine. Broad AncestorSpine T1 fills the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Redguard_AncestorSpine_T1 (R2); broad AncestorSpine T2 is the new PDV_Bless_Redguard_AncestorSpine_T2, capped at Faithful and SUPPRESSED when a focused patron is active (R8). Redguard = Yokudan pantheon. Alkosh is NOT a Redguard deity (confirmed) and is not referenced. Redguard OWNS three new NATIVE deity QUSTs: PDV_Deity_Tuwhacca (death duty / ward / restoration), PDV_Deity_HoonDing (make-way, RARE, weekly cap), PDV_Deity_Leki (sword-singing / one-handed / critical conduct). PDV_Deity_Arkay is REUSED (create:false) ONLY as fallback death-rite infrastructure -- Tu'whacca uses Arkay-adjacent Skyrim spaces (Hall of the Dead) but the worship and ALL Survey/copy say Tu'whacca, never Arkay. Ruptga/Satakal/Tava/Onsi/Sep stay broad-only Yokudan flavor inside the broad-state lane (R5), no records. Ancestor reverence and the Far Shores token are SUPPORT, not a third always-on family (R8): the Far Shores token is a portable/private Tu'whacca devotional surface modeled on the Dunmer portable shrine (homeOrPrivateOnly conditional), feeding the death-duty lane rather than a separate boon. HoonDing rewards carry a weekly cap and require curated make-way drama, never generic combat. T3 recognition = V1 Survey/status text only. Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

stateTrack.reuse: Reuses the skeleton scaffold state-track/global-mirror already record-wired in the framework ESP (PDV_StateTrack_RedguardSect / PDV_GLO_RedguardSect per PDV_Phase20RedguardImplementationCosting.manifest.json). Do NOT recreate; reference only.
stateTrack.switchGates: Crown/Forebear switching requires 2 sect-coded signal days in 7; Ash'abah requires a major death, undead, tomb, funerary, or impurity-burden beat. Setup or credible world evidence only -- not a free menu toggle.
stateTrack.designNote: Sect is the organizing/eligibility layer. It does NOT add its own boon stack; it filters which focused Yokudan patron families and contexts apply (Crown -> Tu'whacca form/orthodoxy emphasis; Forebear -> HoonDing/Leki road-and-adaptation emphasis; Ash'abah -> Tu'whacca death-duty/impurity emphasis). The active boon families remain broad AncestorSpine + one focused Yokudan patron set.

deityQuests.designNote: Yokudan god of souls and death duty. Uses Arkay-adjacent Skyrim spaces (Hall of the Dead, tombs, funerary sites) for hooks, but ALL worship, Survey, and player-facing copy say Tu'whacca, never Arkay. Vampire-cure re-entry to the cycle routes through Tu'whacca.

deityQuests.theme: make-way / movement / one-handed burst (RARE, weekly cap)
deityQuests.designNote: The Make-Way God. Manifests only in rare honorable adversity / impossible-odds / curated make-way milestones. Reward grants carry a weekly cap (one HoonDing make-way reward per 7 in-game days). Generic combat, dungeon clears, and body count never satisfy HoonDing.

Saint of the Spirit Sword, ataxia of the Sword-Singers. Rewards martial CONDUCT and skilled sword-singing form, not raw kills. Requires conduct/context (duel, sword form, honorable defeat of a worthy foe), never generic combat.

reusedDeities.reuse: Owned/created by the Imperial spec. Redguard adds Stance_Redguard ONLY as fallback death-rite INFRASTRUCTURE (Hall of the Dead spaces, vanilla death-rite triggers). Tu'whacca is the god worshipped; Arkay is the proxy space. Survey/copy/Far-Shores text MUST say Tu'whacca, not Arkay. Reconcile via --reconcile-shared-deity (add Stance_Redguard); do NOT recreate the record and do NOT route Redguard worship piety to Arkay.

ownsNewDeities: Redguard creates 3 new NATIVE deity QUSTs (Tu'whacca, HoonDing, Leki), each create:true with next-available deityIndex, Stance_Redguard=0 (NATIVE), added to PDV_FLST_AllDeities. Arkay is reused (create:false) as fallback death-rite infrastructure only. Ruptga/Satakal/Tava/Onsi/Sep stay broad-only Yokudan flavor inside the broad AncestorSpine state lane (R5); no records.

farShoresToken.pattern: Portable/private Tu'whacca devotional surface modeled on the Dunmer portable shrine (homeOrPrivateOnly conditional). It is SUPPORT for the death-duty lane, NOT a third always-on boon family. Tracked as StorageUtil proof texture (PDV.Redguard.FarShoresToken), not an Arkay shrine replacement.
farShoresToken.antiFarm: Far Shores daily cap (one activation credit per in-game day; key PDV.Signal.RedguardFarShoresToken).
farShoresToken.playerFacingText: You keep a token of the Far Shores close, and pray as Tu'whacca's people do in private. At home or in a private place your resistance to magic rises by 5%.
farShoresToken.designNote: Private/home bonus only (homeOrPrivateOnly conditional, mirroring Dunmer homeOrShrineOnly). Counts toward the death-duty/Tu'whacca lane support budget, not a standalone family. Copy stays Yokudan -- says Tu'whacca and Far Shores, never Arkay.

neglect.playerFacingText: The ancestors feel distant and the road is colder. Your resistance to magic falls 3% until you keep the sect and the death duty again.
neglect.designNote: GENTLE by default (ancestor distance, -3% ResistMagic). Neglect BITES harder only at curse posture or Ash'abah stigma (handled by curse-state / stigma copy in requiredContentRows, not a larger spell magnitude here). Neglect is distinct from creed-violation loss.

creedViolationLoss.policy: Medium/major only; 2-3 negative deltas. Distinct from gentle neglect drift.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The Redguard Survey reports active sect (Crown/Forebear/Ash'abah) and why, broad/focused state, primary Yokudan patron and tier, Tu'whacca death-duty / Far Shores token state, Ash'abah impurity burden, HoonDing weekly-cap state, and vampire/werewolf curse-cycle pressure -- all in Yokudan terms (Tu'whacca, never Arkay). Voiced NPC recognition (Hall of the Dead / tombkeeper / Alik'r-facing topics, Ash'abah stigma lines) is V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families only: broad AncestorSpine lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + one active focused Yokudan patron set (Tu'whacca OR HoonDing OR Leki, Layer 2, T1/T2/T3). Broad stays softer than focused and is suppressed under focus. Ancestor reverence and the Far Shores token are SUPPORT for the death-duty/Tu'whacca lane, NOT a third always-on boon family. HoonDing is a rare weekly-capped make-way burst, not a steady combat loop. Sect (Crown/Forebear/Ash'abah) is an eligibility/filter layer, not a boon stack. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Redguard ceiling: 'Broad sect worship reaches Faithful; Devoted requires focused primary; ancestor reverence and Far Shores token should support, not create a third always-on boon family.' No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

ruleCompliance.R1: Broad AncestorSpine is a STATE on PATRON_STATE_BROAD gated by PDV_State_RedguardSect; NO PDV_Deity_AncestorSpine record.
ruleCompliance.R2: Broad T1 uses the FIXED editorId PDV_Bless_Redguard_AncestorSpine_T1; broad T2 = PDV_Bless_Redguard_AncestorSpine_T2.
ruleCompliance.R3: Focused 3-tier sets follow PDV_Bless_Redguard_<Patron>_T1/T2/T3 for Tu'whacca/HoonDing/Leki; grant logic mirrors SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards/Family.
ruleCompliance.R4: Arkay is a SHARED record (owned by Imperial, create:false here, Stance_Redguard added via reconcile); Tu'whacca/HoonDing/Leki are new owned records.
ruleCompliance.R5: Only focusable Yokudan patrons get records (Tu'whacca/HoonDing/Leki). Ruptga/Satakal/Tava/Onsi/Sep stay broad-only flavor, no records. Alkosh is NOT referenced (not a Redguard deity).
ruleCompliance.R6: No new Daedric Prince records; Daedric forks route through the Phase 20C Daedric system. (Redguard has no native Daedric lane in this spec.)
ruleCompliance.R7: Gate type = state-enum-gated: rewards gate on PDV_State_RedguardSect + focused patron tier within the sect; offer-like for the focused patron.
ruleCompliance.R8: <=2 always-on families (broad AncestorSpine + one focused Yokudan patron); ancestor reverence + Far Shores token are SUPPORT not a 3rd family; broad < focused (suppressed under focus); HoonDing weekly cap; one anti-farm mechanism per act; per-tier magnitude ceiling ~12% (max used = 12% OneHanded T3 / 15% HealRateMult T3 within ledger ceiling band); creed-violation loss medium/major only (3 entries). ASCII-only text; Skyrim ActorValue names (ResistMagic, DamageResist, HealRateMult, OneHanded, CriticalChance, SpeedMult); deityIndex next-available; Arkay create:false (infra only).
